tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Thank you for applying for our exchange program. Let’s start with your basic experience. Have you ever participated in a student exchange program before? If so, where did you go and what was your major purpose? If not, what type of program would interest you?
tasks.analysis: 中文：感谢你申请我们的交换项目。我们先从你的基本经历开始吧。你之前参加过学生交换项目吗？如果参加过，你去了哪里，主要目的是什么？如果没有，你对哪种类型的项目感兴趣？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: I see. Some students prefer short-term exchanges (2-3 weeks) to minimize academic disruption, while others insist semester-long programs are necessary for cultural immersion. Which approach do you think is more valuable for language learning specifically, and why?
tasks.analysis: 中文：我明白了。有些学生倾向于 2-3 周的短期交换，以尽量减少对学业的影响；也有学生认为，要真正融入当地文化，一学期的交换项目是必要的。就语言学习而言，你认为哪种方式更有价值？为什么？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Interesting. Imagine two host universities: one in a bustling capital city with many international students, another in a small town with strong local traditions. Which environment would you choose?
tasks.analysis: 中文：有意思。想象一下有两所东道主大学：一所位于繁华的首都城市，有很多国际学生；另一所位于一个小镇，有浓厚的当地传统。你会选择哪种环境？
tasks.title: Interview

tasks.instruction: Listen to the question, then respond.
tasks.stem: Good points. Lastly, recent studies show some exchange students experience ‘reverse culture shock’ upon returning home. Do you believe universities should provide reorientation programs for returnees? What specific support mechanisms would you recommend?
tasks.analysis: 中文：说得有道理。最后一个问题，很多留学生在刚到海外新环境时都会经历适应困难。你认为大学应该做些什么来帮助学生，在他们出发之前就提前帮助他们减少这种适应上的困难？
tasks.title: Interview
